seoDescr: How to order Payment methods Cryptocurrency Receipt of product Refund
howToOrder1: 1. If you are not logged in, please log in or register.
howToOrder2: 2. Select products and add them to your cart.
howToOrder3: 3. Go to the Cart section and click Go to Checkout.
paymentMethodsTitle: During checkout you will see the available payment methods. At the moment payment in cryptocurrency is available. The list of supported cryptocurrencies may change.
paymentMethodsTitle2: The following cryptocurrencies are supported: BTC, BCH, XMR, ETH, USDT (ERC20), LTC, BNB, USDT (BEP20), MATIC, USDT (TRC20), TRX, USDT (MATIC).
paymentMethodsTitle3: The list of supported cryptocurrencies may change.
cryptocurrencySubHdrTitle: The network (blockchain) fee for the transfer is paid by the buyer.
receiptProductTitle: After payment, the user will be redirected to the Orders section of his personal cabinet, where he will be able to download the purchased product. A download link will also be sent to the e-mail address.
refundTitle: All digital goods are non-returnable. Exceptions may be made for poor quality or misleading products.
